name: Modern Hebrew (Advanced Language Study)
description: Certificate of Advanced Language Study in Modern Hebrew offered by the Department of Near Eastern Languages and Civilizations. A certificate adviser advises students on the certification process. The certificate is listed on the student's transcript once completed.
notes: Letter grade B or above required in all courses
Declare candidacy on Yale Hub as early as possible, no later than January 15 or September 15 of final semester
With adviser approval, one advanced non-L5 Yale course and/or a graduate or advanced seminar may count
One LxC course taught in English may count if it includes a weekly discussion section conducted entirely in Hebrew (minimum three students; course designated LxC)
Up to two study-abroad credits taught in Hebrew may be substituted with adviser approval

requirements.name: Courses beyond L4
requirements.description: Four courses beyond the L4 level in Modern Hebrew. At least two must be Yale courses designated L5.
